english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for finding or learning something for the first time.

exampleSentences.english: I discover today that they can speak Cantonese.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今日先發現原來佢識講廣東話。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sin1 faat3 jin6 jyun4 loi4 keoi5 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2

english.note: Use this when you discover something, especially when you come across it or realize it rather than locate it physically.

exampleSentences.english: We detect a change in his attitude.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 faat3 jin6 keoi5 taai3 dou6 bin3 zo2

english.note: Use this when the notice involves discovering or realizing a fact, often unexpectedly.

exampleSentences.english: I only notice when I get home that my keys are missing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我返到屋企先發現唔見咗鎖匙。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 faat3 jin6 m4 gin3 zo2 so2 si4

english.note: Use 發現 when catch means notice or discover something, including discovering someone doing something wrong, rather than physically seizing them.

exampleSentences.english: I catch them secretly eating my bag of chips.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我發現佢偷偷食緊我嗰包薯片。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 faat3 jin6 keoi5 tau1 tau1 sik6 gan2 ngo5 go2 baau1 syu4 pin2

english.note: Use 發現 when you discover something, whether by chance or through study or investigation.

exampleSentences.english: I find out that this method does not work only after completing the experiment.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我做完個實驗先發現原來呢個方法唔得。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 go3 sat6 jim6 sin1 faat3 jin6 jyun4 loi4 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 dak1
